name: A cup of eternity
source:
Tonight marks your wedding night and the first meeting with your husband. You don't lament it though. Fate gave you an absolutely alluring and seemingly gentle groom. When he serves you a cup of bridal wine, you happily comply…only to drop dead on the floor.  

The next time you open your eyes, you find yourself back at the same table. Your murderer once again smilingly offers you a cup of poisoned wine.  

Change his mind to survive the night! A few calculated moves and sweet talking might do the trick. Unless you try to…poison him?


[From [url=https://calnite.itch.io/a-cup-of-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今晚是你们的新婚之夜，也是与丈夫的第一次见面。但你并不为此哀叹。命运给了你一个绝对迷人又看似温柔的新郎。当他给你倒了一杯新娘酒时，你很高兴地答应了……结果却倒在了地板上死了。

当你下次睁开眼睛时，你发现自己又回到了同一张桌子。凶手再次微笑着给你递上一杯毒酒。

改变主意才能度过这一夜！一些经过深思熟虑的举动和甜言蜜语可能会奏效。除非你试图……毒害他？


[来自[url=https://calnite.itch.io/a-cup-of-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
